The locally led organisation Action pour le Bien-être Communautaire (ABCom) is implementing the project “Emergency and Post-Emergency Resilience for the Population of the Mweso Health Zone, Masisi Territory, North Kivu, DRC” in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) with a total budget of 5 million Swedish kronor, for the period 2025–2026.
The intervention will address the urgent needs of 1,150 displaced households experiencing food insecurity in the Mweso and Masisi health districts. The project combines immediate assistance with measures to strengthen resilience by providing agricultural tools, seeds, and food support so that households can make optimal use of the inputs. The households also receive conditional cash grants for income-generating activities, as well as training and capacity building in agroecology and sustainable farming methods to promote environmentally friendly practices and long-term food security.
